Pre-existing -- the build script globs the function directory -- and the import-closure check passes, so nothing breaks today; the manifest's stated reason for excluding resolver (a pandas dependency the runtime lacks) is a live risk only if something ever imports it at runtime. The issuer confirmed the stale digest was its own carrier error and corrected it at 41de7149ae. Recorded because the general form is worth more than the instance: a declared digest that fails is not automatically a corrupted artifact -- it is equally often a correct artifact against a stale declaration, and only tracing the pins tells you which.

A gate that only blocks is worth less than one that is read.
